welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.
welcomeTitle.translation: A re u lokisetseng ketelo ea hao.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Araba lipotso tse seng kae ka matšoao a hao. Ngaka ea hao e hlahloba ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe pele u kopana le eona.

btnStart.translation: Qala ho hlahloba pele ho ketelo

btnInviteCode.translation: Ke na le khoutu ea memo

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Sena se amahanya ketelo ea hao le tlaleho ea hao.

labelComplaint.translation: Ke'ng e u tlisitseng mona kajeno?

placeholderComplaint.translation: Hlalosa matšoao a hao a ka sehloohong...

interviewAsking.translation: Ho botsa ka matšoao a hao

interviewLoadError.translation: Re ne re sa khone ho kenya puisano ea hao.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Kea leboha Ke tla u botsa lipotso tse seng kae tse potlakileng mabapi le hore na ke'ng e u tlisitseng mona.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Tlanya karabo, kapa u tobetse tlhahiso e ka holimo

severityWorst.translation: Ntho e mpe ka ho fetisisa eo e kileng ea e-ba teng

reviewTitle.translation: Mona ke seo ke se hlokometseng

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Tobetsa ntho leha e le efe e le hore u e lokise pele u e romela.

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Ho bonahala eka ho nepahetse romela ho ngaka

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Haeba matšoao a hao a le matla kapa a ntse a mpefala hona joale, u se ke ua ema letsetsa litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Ka kōpo batla tlhokomelo nakong ea lihora tse 12

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Matšoao a hao a bontša ntho e lokelang ho bonoa haufinyane.

urgencyStep1Title.translation: Tlhahisoleseling ea hau e rometsoe hona joale

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Sehlopha sa bongaka se fumana histori ea hao e hlophisitsoeng hang-hang.

urgencyStep2Title.translation: E bonoe nakong ea lihora tse 12

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Haeba boemo bo mpefala, nka bohato kapele

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Ho mpefala ho tebileng kapa ho sa lebelloang letsetsa litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso hang-hang.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Ena ke tlhahlobo ea tšohanyetso e ikemetseng, eseng tlhahlobo ea mafu.

notADiagnosisBold.translation: ha ho na tlhahlobo ea mafu

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: U kile ua bonoa sepetlele sena pele.

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Ba se ba ntse ba e-na le lirekoto tsa hao, kahoo sehlopha sa hao sa tlhokomelo se bona histori ea hao e feletseng hang-hang.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?
findSearchTitle.translation: U ka rata ho bonoa hokae?

findScanning.translation: Ho hlahloba lipetlele tsa Triavi tse haufi le uena...

findLevelReady.translation: Tekanyo ea {level} e se e loketse

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: Ha rea ka ra fumana moo u leng teng.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Tlhahisoleseding ea hao e sehlopheng sa tlhokomelo, re tla u tsebisa hang ha ngaka e e bula.

timelineReviewing.translation: Ngaka e hlahloba boitsebiso ba hao

timelineOpened.translation: Ngaka e ile ea bula buka ea hao

btnSymptomsWorse.translation: Matšoao a mpefala le ho feta

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Haeba ho ntse ho mpefala, nka khato hona joale

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: U se ke ua emela hore u eme moleng. Haeba matšoao a hao a le matla kapa a mpefala ka tšohanyetso letsetsa litšebeletso tsa tšohanyetso hona joale kapa u ee lefapheng la tšohanyetso le haufi.

escalateNotDiagnosis.translation: ha ho na tlhahlobo ea mafu

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Re tšoaile nyeoe ea hao e le ea bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa e le hore sehlopha sa tlhokomelo se tsebe.

notifyTitle.translation: Triavi · Tlhahisoleseling ea hau e bulehile

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Ngaka e hlahloba boitsebiso ba hao, re tla u tsebisa ha bo ntse bo tsoela pele.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Araba lipotso tse seng kae mabapi le kamoo u 'nileng ua itšoara kateng ho tloha ketelong ea hao.

checkinTrendSame.translation: Hoo e ka bang ka tsela e tšoanang

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Boemo ba hao bo bapisoa joang le ba pele?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Na ho na le ntho e 'ngoe eo u ka ratang ho re bolella eona?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Re thabile hore ebe u ikutloa u le betere

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today
checkinResultReview.translation: Lingaka li tla hlahloba sena kajeno

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Likarabo tsa hao li rometsoe sehlopheng sa tlhokomelo 'me ngaka e tla li hlahloba 'me haeba ho hlokahala e ikopanye le uena.

checkinResultEscalate.translation: Ka kōpo batla tlhokomelo hona joale

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Matšoao a hao a bontša hore ho na le ntho e hlokang tlhokomelo e potlakileng.

checkinExpired.translation: Khokahano ena ea ho kena e felile

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Tlhokomelo ena ha e sa fumaneha. Ingolise ho bona boitsebiso ba hao ba morao-rao.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Etsa akhaonto e sa lefelloeng ho latela ketelo ena 'me u tlole khoutu nakong e tlang.

authVerifyTitle.translation: A re netefatse hore ke uena

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Re tla romela khoutu ea nako e le 'ngoe ha ho na phasewete eo u ka e hopolang.

authSecuredBy.translation: E sirelelitsoe ke Triavi · e lumellanang le HIPAA

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otpSentTo.translation: E romeloa ho {dest}. E felloa ke nako ka mor'a metsotso e 10.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Kenya mohala oa hao kapa lengolo-tsoibila 'me re tla romela khoutu ea ho kena.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Ak'haonte ea hao e hokahane le litlaleho tsa sepetlele sa hao

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)
errInvalidPhone.translation: Kenya nomoro ea mohala e nepahetseng (linomoro tsa 714)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Ha kea khona ho romela khoutu.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Phoso ea marang-rang, hlahloba khokahano ea hau 'me u leke hape.

errResendFailed.translation: Ke ne ke sa khone ho e romela hape, leka hape.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.
errCodeMismatch.translation: Khoutu eo e ne e sa lumellane, leka hape.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Ka lebaka la polokeho ea hao le ho sireletsa boitsebiso ba mokuli, u saennoe ka mor'a nako ea ho se sebetse.

dashNoActive.translation: Ha ho na ketelo e sebetsang

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Qala ho kena e le hore u qale ketelo e ncha.

dashNoPastVisits.translation: Ha ho na maeto a fetileng.

dashFollowUp.translation: Tlhahlobo e latelang ea ho kena

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Mehala ea tlhokomelo e letsetsa appeng ena · nomoro ea hau ea mohala ha e arolelanoe.

dashSimulateCall.translation: Ho etsisa mohala o kenang oa tlhokomelo · demo

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Khetha hore na ke mang ea u bitsang le hore na ba utloahala joang.

toneWarmDesc.translation: Ho khothatsa le ho se potlake

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Ka ho toba, ka ho hlaka, ha ho na lipuo tse litšila

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Lumela Jordan, ke nako ea hore u noe lijo tsa mantsiboea...

medReminderCalls.translation: Mehala ea ho hopotsa batho ka meriana

medReminderCallsDesc.translation: Ring ka tekanyo e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e reriloeng

postVisitCalls.translation: Mehala ea ho kena ka mor'a ketelo

postVisitCallsDesc.translation: "U ikutloa joang?" ka mor'a ho lokolloa

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Ha ho na mehala ea 9:30 PM 7:30 AM · e khutlela tsebisong

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Mohala oa hau oa tlhokomelo o lula o sebetsa kena hape ho laola mehala le likhopotso.

welcomeMyDashboard.translation: Letlapa la ka la ho hlophisa

callRingVerified.translation: E netefalitsoe · ka mohala oa hau oa tlhokomelo {code}

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Mohala oa lentsoe o patiloeng · WebRTC · nomoro ea hau ha e arolelanoe

callActiveUnmute.translation: Ha ho letho le sa buuoeng

callSummaryReported.translation: E Tlisetsoa Sehlopha sa Hao sa Tlhokomelo

callSummarySnoozed.translation: HO HLOKOA HO HLOKOA HO HLOKOA HO HLOKOA HO HLOKOA HO HLOKOA

callSummaryNoContact.translation: HA HO NA Karabo E TSOANG KA MOLEMO

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Ke uena feela le {hospital} ba ka bonang tsena. Tlanya ketelo ho bala kakaretso e arolelanoeng le uena.

visitDetailCalls.translation: LITLHAKU TSA TŠEBELETSO TSA TŠEBELETSO ENA

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Ha ho hlokahale hore u tšoenyehe ka ketelo ena hajoale.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Ena ke kakaretso e arolelanoeng le uena eseng tlhahlobo. Haeba matšoao a hao a khutla kapa a mpefala, batla thuso ea tšohanyetso hang-hang.

visitDetailNotFound.translation: Ha rea ka ra fumana ketelo eo

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Mohlomong ketelo ena e tlositsoe, kapa sehokela ha se sa sebetsa.

visitDetailBackToVisits.translation: Khutlela maetong a nakong e fetileng

visitDetailDischargeBadge.translation: E lokollotsoe ke sehlopha sa hao sa tlhokomelo

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Ntlafatsa lintlha tsa hao. Ngaka ea hao e tla bona se etsahalang morao-rao.

placeholderEmergencyName.translation: Lebitso la motho eo u kopanang le eena ka tšohanyetso

placeholderEmergencyPhone.translation: Nomoro ea mohala ea motho eo u kopanang le eena

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: E fetola puo ea skrine e 'ngoe le e' ngoe hang-hang.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Ha ke khone ho kopitsa - khetha le ho kopitsa ka letsoho

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Seo re se sireletsang le seo u se laolang.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Lebitso la hao, lintlha tsa hao tsa ho ikopanya le likarabo tsa hao tse sa lefelloeng li tlosoa pele ntho leha e le efe e tloha sepetlele sa hao. Ke sehlopha sa hao sa tlhokomelo feela se bonang lintlha tse khethollang; lipatlisiso le li-analytics li bona lintlha tse sa khetholloeng feela.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Lumella boitsebiso bo sa tsejoeng hore bo ntlafatse tlhokomelo bakeng sa bohle. U ka fetola sena neng kapa neng.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: U ka fetola sena ka nako leha e le efe.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Ka ho sa feleng tlosa akhaonto ea hao le boitsebiso ba hao ba ho ikopanya le bona.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Kōpa kopi ea kakaretso ea ketelo ea hao, meriana le histori ea ho letsetsa tlhokomelo.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Sena se tlosa akhaonto ea hao le boitsebiso ba hao ba ho ikopanya le bona ka ho sa feleng.

deleteRequestSubmitted.translation: Kopo ea ho hlakola e rometsoe

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Sehlopha sa hao sa tlhokomelo se tla netefatsa ka lengolo-tsoibila nakong ea lihora tse 72.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Khetha foromo 'me u kope ho romeloa linaheng tse ling. Re tla e lokisetsa 'me re romele khokahano e sireletsehileng ho imeile ea hau e ngolisitsoeng.

downloadSheetConfirm.translation: Kopo ea ho romella thepa kantle ho naha

downloadRequestSubmitted.translation: Kopo ea kantle ho naha e rometsoeng

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Re tla romella lengolo-tsoibila le sireletsehileng ho aterese ea hau e ngolisitsoeng nakong ea lihora tse 24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Ha ho na lifaele tse jarollotsoeng mona - litlaleho tsa hao li romeloa ka mokhoa o sireletsehileng ho lengolo-tsoibila la hao le ngolisitsoeng.

ariaSeverityScale.translation: Boima ho tloha ho 1 ho isa ho 10

callSummaryNoAnswerPlain.translation: Ha ho na karabo e ngotsoeng

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact
callSummaryDeclinedLogged.translation: Mohala o ile oa hana ' me oa ngolisoa e le ha ho na puisano

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Tšoaea khokahano ea memo eo sepetlele sa hao se u rometseng eona, kapa u hlahlobe khoutu ea bona ea QR.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Seo ha se tšoane le khokahano ea memo ea Triavi kapa khoutu.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteCameraDenied.translation: Ho kena ha khamera ho hanetsoe

inviteEnterManually.translation: Kenya khokahano ea memo ka letsoho

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Khoutu e sebetsang ea tleliniki e u isa ka ho toba linthong tsa hao.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Khoutu e sebetsang ea tleliniki e u isa ka ho toba linthong tsa hao.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Fana ka tumello ea kh'amera ho li-setting tsa sebatli sa hau, kapa kenya sehokela sa memo ka letsoho.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Ha ho na kh'amera e fumanoeng.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Khamera ha e fumanehe hona joale. Kenya khokahano ea memo ka letsoho.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Offline? ho bontša sengoloa sa puisano se bolokiloeng

otpGroupAriaLabel.translation: Khoutu ea nako e le 'ngoe, ea linomoro tse 6
